WITH ae_pipeline AS (
    SELECT
        sp.account_executive_employee_id AS employee_id,
        SUM(sp.weighted_acv_inr_lakhs) AS weighted_pipeline_acv
    FROM sales_pipeline sp
    WHERE sp.stage NOT IN ('Closed-Won', 'Closed-Lost')
    GROUP BY sp.account_executive_employee_id
), qualifying_account_managers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.account_manager_employee_id AS employee_id
    FROM customers c
    JOIN customer_contracts cc
      ON cc.customer_id = c.customer_id
    JOIN product_feature_adoption pfa
      ON pfa.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE CAST(cc.expiry_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-26' AND DATE '2027-04-26'
